libraryRestore.closeRefreshes: Closing this restore review refreshes the library before you continue.
libraryRestore.content: Copy of the original library folder
libraryRestore.description: You need a library information file and a separate copy of the original library folder. Restore into a new or empty library. Review the destination and copied files first. Portcove copies and verifies the restored content before opening the library. A review alone does not verify a complete recovery copy. The originals stay where they are.

recovery.heading: Finish the interrupted library restore
recovery.intro: Resume the restore to verify and finish opening the copied library. The Portcove export stays unchanged. Incomplete copies remain closed until recovery succeeds.
recovery.label: Library restore recovery

libraryRestore.title: Restore from a library copy
libraryRestore.trust: Use an export you trust. Review its source, destination, required space, installed versions, saved file locations, and copied files before restoring it.
